ui:custom: Run a custom interface in a sandboxed iframe
ui:project-data: Disclose plugin results to its custom interface
files:choose: Read local files you explicitly choose for this plugin
files:save: Request a text, image or ZIP file download, confirmed by you
files:save-html: Request a web page download, confirmed by you; the page contains this plugin's code, which runs when you open the file
editor:place-items: Request item placement, confirmed by you in the editor
project:read-info: Read metadata and file names in the current project
documents:read: Read the current editor document, including all its items and embedded symbols
editor:read-selection: Read selected item IDs in the current editor
editor:select: Change which items are selected in the current editor
storage:local: Store local data for this plugin, account and project
project:export: Generate export files such as Gerbers, drill files and netlists from the current document on PCBJam's servers
ui:open-external: Open pages of this plugin's approved sites in a new browser tab, after you confirm
